Description
At Justin-Siena, students attend an elite private school with access to a strong arts program, advanced engineering courses and interscholastic athletics. The school offers students a four-year application-based engineering program with Project Lead the Way, as well as networking opportunities with successful alumni, including those who work in Hollywood and Silicon Valley. Justin-Siena has a strong visual and performing arts program, a unique robotics program and a picturesque, 40-acre park-like campus. Justin-Siena has a vibrant extracurricular program and championship-winning athletic teams. Each year, students are accepted into Ivy League Universities.
